name: Card Shuffle
description: A small stack of cards that cycles, with the front card leaving and rejoining at the back.

props.name: items
props.description: The cards, front first. Each one is placed on a padded card surface; the stack is as tall as its tallest card.

props.name: interval
props.description: Milliseconds each card spends at the front. A hairline along its bottom fills over this time. 0 turns cycling off.

props.name: offset
props.description: How much higher each card behind sits, in pixels.

props.name: scaleStep
props.description: How much smaller each card behind is, as a fraction.

props.name: draggable
props.description: Lets the front card be flicked away sideways.

props.name: cardClassName
props.description: Extra classes for every card surface.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Name for the stack, which is a focusable region. Focus pauses it; the right and down arrow keys move it on.
